plugins.name: claudesama
plugins.description: Unofficial fan skin for Claude Code, not affiliated with Anthropic. A small kami of words sits above your prompt, reacts to what your session is doing and says a short line now and then. Works in the terminal and in the desktop Code tab. No network calls, no telemetry.
